source_text: De sacrificiis pro ignorantia et non voluntate. Pontifex etiam pro ignorantia sua offert. Lex misericors: nescientia non est innocentia absoluta.
pass_a_gloss: About sacrifices for ignorance and not by-will. High-priest also for ignorance his offers. Law merciful: not-knowing not is innocence absolute.
pass_b_english: These sacrifices cover ignorance and unwilling fault. Even the high priest offers [[for his ignorance >> Bible:Leviticus 4:3]]. The law is merciful — yet not-knowing is not absolute innocence.
